scripts.build:node: mkdir -p dist && bun build --format=cjs --target=node --external koffi index.js --outfile dist/node-bundle.cjs && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && cp $(which node) hypermatch3d-node && npx postject hypermatch3d-node NODE_SEA_BLOB dist/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2 && chmod +x hypermatch3d-node && echo 'Node executable: ./hypermatch3d-node'
scripts.build:node-win: NODE_VER=$(node --version) && mkdir -p dist && bun build --format=cjs --target=node --external koffi index.js --outfile dist/node-bundle.cjs && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && curl -fL "https://nodejs.org/dist/${NODE_VER}/node-${NODE_VER}-win-x64.zip" -o dist/node-win.zip && unzip -p dist/node-win.zip "node-${NODE_VER}-win-x64/node.exe" > hypermatch3d-node.exe && npx postject hypermatch3d-node.exe NODE_SEA_BLOB dist/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2 && echo 'Done: ship hypermatch3d-node.exe + SDL2.dll + node_modules/koffi/'
scripts.docker_run: xhost + && sudo docker run --rm -v /tmp/.X11-unix:/tmp/.X11-unix:ro -e DISPLAY=$DISPLAY hypermatch3d
